objective: Standard editorial review of a valid CEIS topic page with up to two related topics consulted.
prompt: Review the CEIS topic page 'data-capture-standards--d1d8e601.aspx' for editorial completeness, logical structure, and consistency with related standards.
expected_semantic_behaviours: Identifies the primary topic reviewed with title or URL.
Consults up to 2 directly related topics as evidence inputs if referenced.
Provides editorial completeness findings and recommended human follow-ups.
Remains consistent and stable across repeated runs.
prohibited_behaviours: Do not attempt to write to SharePoint list items or documents.
Do not claim to cryptographically verify machine-owned content SHA-256 hashes.
Do not consult more than 2 related topic pages.
_normalization_note: primary_topic retains the native-runtime .aspx/.html filename as originally authored (Phase 4); primary_topic_slug is the runtime-agnostic form both runtimes' harnesses should resolve against their own native extension.
